ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $OC$ is outside $\angle AOB$, and $OM$, $ON$ are the angle bisectors of $\angle AOC$ and $\angle BOC$, respectively. If $\angle AOB=110^\circ$ and $\angle BOC=60^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle MON$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle AOB=110^\circ$ and $\angle BOC=60^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle AOC=\angle AOB+\angle BOC=170^\circ$,\\
since OM bisects $\angle AOC$,\\
thus $\angle MOC=\angle MOA=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOC=85^\circ$,\\
since ON bisects $\angle BOC$,\\
thus $\angle BON=\angle CON=30^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle MON=\angle COM-\angle CON=\boxed{55^\circ}$;
